name: Kuzhu Jiuzhu Zhongxin III
source:
This work tells part of the story before Zhang Ji established the "Lovelorn Sanatorium" in the previous title. Zhang Ji was originally an ordinary migrant worker, but he suffered a sudden accident, and his only relative died in a factory accident. Afterwards, he was forced to lose his job, blamed for an accident by an unscrupulous boss, and suffered a series of unfair treatment and blows such as telecom fraud, and was arrested and imprisoned. When his life fell into a trough, he met his father's only relic during his lifetime, a talking rabbit, and started the funny work of "Lovelorn Sanatorium".

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2307120/Lovelorn_sanatorium/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
本作講述前作中張吉成立「苦主救助中心」之前的一部分故事。張吉原本只是普通的勞工，卻突遭橫禍，唯一的親人在工廠事故中喪生。之後，他又被迫失業，遭無良老闆推卸事故責任，並經歷電信詐騙等一連串不公與打擊，最終被捕入獄。人生跌入谷底時，他遇見了父親生前留下的唯一遺物——一隻會說話的兔子，從此開始了搞怪的「苦主救助」工作。

[根據[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2307120/Lovelorn_sanatorium/]Steam[/url]介紹整理]
